messages:
maria: Customer reported our A/B dashboard shows variant counts flipped for experiment `signup_flow_v2`. They say variant labels look swapped — traffic clearly assigned to B in logs but dashboard shows majority under A. Escalating because they're seeing funnel delta in prod :grimacing:
support-bot: New support case #S-2026-174 created for the customer. Assigned to oncall_eng. :white_check_mark:
devin: @maria can you drop the experiment_id and sample user_ids so I can query assignment logs? Also which dashboard time range?
maria: experiment_id=exp_9762, sample user_ids ["u_1032","u_8241","u_9982"], customer window 2026-02-14T09:00Z -> 2026-02-14T12:00Z. They attached screenshot: https://files.redwood.internal/attachments/exp9762_dashboard_swap.png :eyes:
ivan: Looking at assignment event stream for that interval. Quick grep shows assign events for those users mapping to variant B: e.g.
```
{"ts":"2026-02-14T09:12:01Z","user_id":"u_1032","exp_id":"exp_9762","assigned_variant":"B","bucket":0.723}
{"ts":"2026-02-14T09:15:12Z","user_id":"u_8241","exp_id":"exp_9762","assigned_variant":"B","bucket":0.647}
```
elena: I pulled the analytics aggregate counts (dashboard source) and got: 
```
SELECT variant, count(*) FROM analytics.assignment_aggregates
WHERE exp_id='exp_9762' AND ts >= '2026-02-14' AND ts < '2026-02-15'
GROUP BY variant;
-- results: A: 18,432  B: 3,212
```
maria: which is wild because raw assignment logs show the opposite. Could be a join/ETL problem or label mapping changed at aggregation time.
devin: Heads up — we rolled rollout-service v2.3.1 at 2026-02-14T08:45Z. That deploy included a change to variant label normalization (internal change in how variants map to label keys). Possible mapping migration bug. :thinking_face:
ivan: I ran a consistency query joining raw assignment events to analytics table on user_id+exp_id and found many rows where event.assigned_variant='B' but analytics.variant='A'. Sample mismatch: 
```
-- sample join
SELECT e.user_id, e.assigned_variant as event_v, a.variant as agg_v
FROM events.assignments e
LEFT JOIN analytics.assignment_aggregates a
  ON e.user_id = a.user_id AND e.exp_id = a.exp_id AND date(e.ts)=date(a.ts)
WHERE e.exp_id='exp_9762' AND date(e.ts) = '2026-02-14' AND e.user_id IN ('u_1032','u_8241')
LIMIT 50;
```
-- shows event_v=B, agg_v=A for ~42 rows
devin: That smells like a key rewrite during the ETL where variant label keys were remapped based on a new canonicalization table. I pushed a quick check: the mapping table `exp_variant_keys` was updated in the same deploy window with reversed order for this experiment due to a bad migration script.
elena: Confirmed: migration `20260214_variant_normalize` had logic that flips labels if `variant.name` matches regex `^control` — our experiment uses nonstandard names and script coerced them to alphabetical keys. Ops accidentally ran the script against staging+prod.
maria: Oof. Customer impact — dashboard shows wrong counts, but assignment/serving unaffected. They want timeline and mitigation.
ivan: Mitigation options: 1) rollback ETL variant mapping to previous version (fast, will restore dashboard counts) 2) backfill analytics via a backfill job that recomputes aggregates from event logs (safer for audit, slower) 3) both: rollback for immediate fix + backfill for audit.
devin: I'll do a rollback of the mapping table to the pre-deploy snapshot (fast DB op). Scheduling now. @ops-bot can you hold any ETL jobs touching `assignment_aggregates` until we confirm?
ops-bot: Paused nightly ETL pipelines for dataset `assignment_aggregates` starting 2026-02-14T10:00Z. :ok_hand:
devin: Rolled back mapping table at 2026-02-14T10:03Z. Re-ran a quick aggregate diff, now analytics shows A: 3,256  B: 18,403 (matches event stream).
elena: Kicked off backfill job to recompute 2026-02-14 aggregates to be safe. Job id backfill-569. ETA ~35m.
maria: Customer notified, ticket updated with timeline and root cause. They've confirmed counts look right on their side on a quick check. :thumbsup:
ivan: Follow-up actions: PR to add integration test for variant normalization, prevent running migration against prod without guardrails, add a canary flag for mapping migrations. I'll file the PR and a postmortem.
devin: Linking deploy/revert chain: deploy 2026-02-14T08:45Z -> migration 20260214_variant_normalize -> rollback 2026-02-14T10:03Z.
maria: Closing ticket after backfill completes and we confirm no residual drift. Thanks team. :heart:
ops-bot: Backfill job backfill-569 completed at 2026-02-14T10:38Z. Aggregates reconciled. :white_check_mark:
